Algebra I · Lesson 3.5

Rationalizing Denominators

Solve this lesson →All lessons
Problem
3.4 ended by pointing at the division that does not come out clean. Divide 66 by 33​. One student stops at 633​6​, another writes 2323​. The forms look nothing alike, so test them the 1.4 way. Square each exactly, and both land on the same whole number. Enter it.
Show a hint
  • Squaring removes each radical exactly, so both forms square to plain numbers you can compare.
  • Use (ab)2=a2b(b​a​)2=ba2​ on the first form and (cb)2=c2⋅b(cb​)2=c2⋅b on the second.
Show the full solution
(63)2=363=12(3​6​)2=336​=12 and (23)2=4⋅3=12(23​)2=4⋅3=12​. Two positive numbers with the same square must be equal, so both forms name the same number and both answers to the division are correct. This lesson decides which form counts as finished.

Both forms are right, and they are equal. Fractions had the same problem. 69929269​ reduces to 3443​, one number with two spellings, and lowest terms settled which spelling counts as finished. Radicals need a standard form of their own. Before choosing it, name the kind of number sitting in that denominator.

Key idea
Rational and irrational numbers. A rational number is one that can be written as a fraction of two integers. Every integer can be, and so can 225225​, which equals 1515. The symbol does not decide, the value does. A number equal to no fraction of integers is irrational, and 33​ is one. 3.4 already said no whole number or fraction squares to 33, and that claim is used here, not proved. For the hook, 633​6​ keeps its irrational part in the denominator while 2323​ keeps it in the numerator. Only where it sits differs.
Problem
Of the four numbers 225225​, 3333​, −720−207​, and 0.60.6, how many are rational? Enter the count.
Show a hint
  • Test each one against the definition, writable as one integer over another. A radical can hide a whole number.
  • 152=225152=225. Is 3333 a perfect square?
Show the full solution
225=15225​=15, −720−207​ is already a fraction of integers, and 0.6=350.6=53​, while 3333 is no perfect square, so 3333​ is irrational and the count is 33​. Judge each number by its value, not by how it happens to be written.
Key idea
The standard form. Fractions get reduced to lowest terms so that any two answers can be compared at a glance. The same convention extends to radicals. A finished answer carries no radical in its denominator. Rewriting a fraction so that its denominator becomes rational is called rationalizing the denominator, and it is the cleanup rule 3.4 promised. The value never changes, only how it is written. So 633​6​ and 2323​ are the same number, and 2323​ is the one in standard form.
Problem
131313​13​​ equals 11, and multiplying by 11 changes nothing. Multiply 91313​9​ by it, then use the product rule from 3.4 on the bottom. Enter the denominator of the result.
Show a hint
  • The whole question is what 13⋅1313​⋅13​ equals.
  • By the product rule, 13⋅13=13⋅13=16913​⋅13​=13⋅13​=169​.
Show the full solution
913⋅1313=913169=9131313​9​⋅13​13​​=169​913​​=13913​​, so the denominator is 1313​. The radical did not vanish, it moved to the numerator, and the denominator became an integer.
Key idea
Rationalizing abb​a​. Since bb=1b​b​​=1 and b⋅b=bb​⋅b​=b by the product rule, ab⋅bb=abb.b​a​⋅b​b​​=bab​​. The denominator becomes an integer and the numerator absorbs the radical. The move is legal because it is multiplication by 11, which never changes a value. From here on, answers go in the form abccab​​ with bb squarefree, the fraction acca​ in lowest terms, and cc positive.
Problem
Rationalize 41111​4​. Write the result as abccab​​ with bb squarefree, the fraction in lowest terms, and cc positive. Enter a+b+ca+b+c.
Show a hint
  • Multiply by 11 written as 111111​11​​.
  • The result is 4111111411​​. Read off the three numbers.
Show the full solution
411⋅1111=4111111​4​⋅11​11​​=11411​​, so a+b+c=4+11+11=26a+b+c=4+11+11=26​. Nothing cancels here, since 44 and 1111 share no factor.
Key idea
Reduce after, simplify before. The move plants bb in the denominator, and the coefficient upstairs may share a factor with it. Cancel that like any fraction, coefficient against denominator, never the radicand against anything. It also pays to work small. Simplify the denominator's radical first, the 3.4 way, or reduce the fraction first. Both roads reach the same standard form, one just carries smaller numbers the whole way.
Problem
Rationalize 508127127​508​ and reduce. The result is a whole multiple of the radical, a127a127​. Enter aa.
Show a hint
  • Rationalizing is not the last step here. A fraction appears, and it reduces.
  • After the move you have 508127127127508127​​. That fraction is not in lowest terms yet.
Show the full solution
508127=508127127=4127127​508​=127508127​​=4127​, since 508=4⋅127508=4⋅127, so a=4a=4​. Stopping at 508127127127508127​​ is the common miss. That answer is correct but not in lowest terms.
Problem
Rationalize 101515​10​. Write the result as abccab​​ with bb squarefree, the fraction in lowest terms, and cc positive. Enter a+b+ca+b+c.
Show a hint
  • After the move, the plain fraction part is not yet in lowest terms.
  • gcd⁡(10,15)=5gcd(10,15)=5. Cancel it between the coefficient and the denominator.
Show the full solution
1015=101515=215315​10​=151015​​=3215​​, so a+b+c=2+15+3=20a+b+c=2+15+3=20​. The 55 cancels between 1010 and 1515. The radicand 1515 stays put, it is not part of the plain fraction.
Problem
Simplify the radical first this time, the 3.4 way, then rationalize 226452452​226​. Everything collapses to a single radical bb​. Enter bb.
Show a hint
  • 452452 has a perfect-square factor. Take it out before touching the fraction.
  • 452=2113452​=2113​, so the fraction is 2262113=1131132113​226​=113​113​.
Show the full solution
452=2113452​=2113​, so 226452=2262113=113113=113113113=113452​226​=2113​226​=113​113​=113113113​​=113​, and b=113b=113​. The brute road 226452452452226452​​ lands in the same place, just with uglier numbers along the way.
Key idea
Denominators like mbmb​. In ambmb​a​ only the radical factor is irrational. The integer mm is already fine and stays, so multiply by bbb​b​​ alone, amb⋅bb=abmb.mb​a​⋅b​b​​=mbab​​. Two wrong turns tempt here. Multiplying by mbmbmb​mb​​ still works but inflates every number for no gain, and squaring the mm changes the value of the fraction, which no rewrite is allowed to do.
Problem
Rationalize 21451075107​214​ and reduce fully. Write the result as abccab​​ with bb squarefree, the fraction in lowest terms, and cc positive. Enter a+b+ca+b+c.
Show a hint
  • Multiply the top and bottom by 107107​. The result is not yet in lowest terms.
  • That gives 214107535535214107​​, and 535=5⋅107535=5⋅107.
Show the full solution
2145107=2141075⋅107=214107535=210755107​214​=5⋅107214107​​=535214107​​=52107​​, so a+b+c=2+107+5=114a+b+c=2+107+5=114​. The common factor is easy to miss because it is the radicand itself. 107107 divides both 214214 and 535535.
Key idea
Square roots of fractions. The quotient rule from 3.4 splits abba​​ into abb​a​​. Simplify each radical, then rationalize whatever is left in the denominator. One shortcut is worth checking first. Reduce the fraction under the radical before splitting, since the reduced denominator is sometimes a perfect square, and then there is nothing left to rationalize at all.
Problem
Write 19272719​​ as abccab​​ with bb squarefree, the fraction in lowest terms, and cc positive. Here aa may be 11. Enter a+b+ca+b+c.
Show a hint
  • The fraction is already in lowest terms, so split it with the quotient rule.
  • 27=3327​=33​, so the job is to rationalize 193333​19​​.
Show the full solution
1927=1927=1933=19⋅33⋅3=5792719​​=27​19​​=33​19​​=3⋅319​⋅3​​=957​​, so a+b+c=1+57+9=67a+b+c=1+57+9=67​. The numerator radicals merged into 5757​ by the product rule.
Problem
Write 1054848105​​ as abccab​​ with bb squarefree, the fraction in lowest terms, and cc positive, reducing the fraction under the radical before anything else. Here aa may be 11. Enter a+b+ca+b+c.
Show a hint
  • 105105 and 4848 share a factor, and the reduced denominator is special.
  • 10548=351648105​=1635​, and 1616 is a perfect square.
Show the full solution
10548=351648105​=1635​, so 10548=3516=35448105​​=1635​​=435​​ and a+b+c=1+35+4=40a+b+c=1+35+4=40​. Reducing first left nothing to rationalize. The denominator came out whole on its own.
Key idea
Cube-root denominators. One extra copy is not enough, since b3⋅b3=b233b​⋅3b​=3b2​, still a radical. 3.4 said a prime leaves a cube root only in triples, so supply both missing copies at once. Multiply by b23b233b2​3b2​​, and the denominator becomes b33=b3b3​=b, an integer. The idea is unchanged, multiply by 11, chosen so the radical underneath completes to a whole power.
Problem
Rationalize 8413133131​84​, a cube root in the denominator this time. The result has the form 84d3131131843d​​. Enter dd.
Show a hint
  • How many copies of 131131 must sit under a cube root before it comes out whole?
  • You need 13131313 in the denominator, so multiply by 131231312331312​31312​​.
Show the full solution
841313⋅1312313123=841312313133=841716131313131​84​⋅31312​31312​​=31313​8431312​​=13184317161​​, so d=1312=17161d=1312=17161​. One extra copy would have left 1312331312​ in the denominator, still irrational.
Fun fact
Rational and irrational both come from ratio. The Pythagoreans found that a square's diagonal is no ratio of whole numbers, and Greek writers called such lengths alogos, without ratio. The story that Hippasus drowned for revealing it is legend, not record.
Problem
One expression, every tool. Write 1814+21414​18​+214​ as a single fraction abccab​​ with bb squarefree, the fraction in lowest terms, and cc positive. Rationalize first, then combine like radicals as in 3.4 over a common denominator as in 2.5. Enter a+b+ca+b+c.
Show a hint
  • Rationalize and reduce the first term. Both terms then become multiples of 1414​.
  • 1814=914714​18​=7914​​ and 214=14147214​=71414​​.
Show the full solution
1814=181414=914714​18​=141814​​=7914​​, and 214=14147214​=71414​​, so the sum is 914+14147=231477914​+1414​​=72314​​ and a+b+c=23+14+7=44a+b+c=23+14+7=44​. Standard form is what made the two terms combinable at all.

Chapter 3 stretched the exponent laws to zero, negatives, and fractions, turned fractional powers into radicals, and closed with a standard form for answers. All of it was rewriting, one expression traded for an equal one. Chapter 4 turns to solving, where a claim of equality can be true or false. 4.1 starts with what an equation says.

Practice these ideas

Practice
Exactly one of 8181​ and 8787​ is rational. Decide which one, and enter the value of the rational one as a plain integer.
Show the solution
81=9281=92, so 81=981​=9​, which is rational. 8787 sits between 92=8192=81 and 102=100102=100, so no integer squares to 8787, and 3.4 said no fraction does either, so 8787​ is irrational.
Practice
To rationalize a fraction whose denominator is 9595​, you multiply by 959595​95​​. Enter the value of that multiplier as a single number.
Show the solution
9595​ is a nonzero number, and any nonzero number over itself equals 11​. Multiplying by 11 changes how a fraction looks, never its value, and that is what makes rationalizing legal.
Practice
Rationalizing works because of one product. Enter the exact value of 103⋅103103​⋅103​.
Show the solution
103⋅103=1032=103103​⋅103​=1032​=103​. This product is what every rationalization uses. One more copy of the radical turns it into an integer.
Practice
Rationalize 128989​12​ and write it as abccab​​ with bb squarefree, the fraction in lowest terms, and cc positive. Enter cc.
Show the solution
1289⋅8989=12898989​12​⋅89​89​​=891289​​, already in lowest terms, so c=89c=89​.
Practice
Rationalize 165555​16​ and write it as abccab​​ with bb squarefree, the fraction in lowest terms, and cc positive. Enter a+b+ca+b+c, a plus b plus c, as a single number.
Show the solution
1655=16555555​16​=551655​​. Since 1616 and 5555 share no factor, this is finished, and a+b+c=16+55+55=126a+b+c=16+55+55=126​.
Practice
Rationalizing never changes a number's value, and squaring can prove it. Square 5088​50​ exactly and enter the result as a fraction in lowest terms.
Show the solution
(508)2=502(8)2=25008=6252(8​50​)2=(8​)2502​=82500​=2625​​. Rationalized or not, 5088​50​ squares to this same number, which is what calling the two forms equal means.
Practice
Rationalize 603030​60​ and reduce. The result is a whole multiple of the radical, a30a30​. Enter aa.
Show the solution
6030=603030=23030​60​=306030​​=230​, so a=2a=2​. Stopping at 603030306030​​ leaves the fraction unreduced, so it is not standard form yet.
Practice
A student rationalizes 585858​58​ by multiplying only the denominator by 5858​, gets 58585858​, and answers 11. The real value is bb​. Enter bb.
Show the solution
5858⋅5858=585858=5858​58​⋅58​58​​=585858​​=58​, so b=58b=58​. The student's one-sided move divided the value by 5858​, which no rewrite is allowed to do.
Practice
Rationalize 2521392139​25​ and write it as abccab​​ with bb squarefree, the fraction in lowest terms, and cc positive. Enter cc.
Show the solution
252139⋅139139=251392⋅139=251392782139​25​⋅139​139​​=2⋅13925139​​=27825139​​. Since 2525 and 278278 share no factor, c=278c=278​.
Practice
Rationalize 93462462​93​ and reduce fully. Write it as abccab​​ with bb squarefree, the fraction in lowest terms, and cc positive. Enter a+b+ca+b+c, a plus b plus c, as a single number.
Show the solution
93462=93624⋅62=9362248462​93​=4⋅629362​​=2489362​​. Both 93=3⋅3193=3⋅31 and 248=8⋅31248=8⋅31 carry a 3131, so the fraction reduces to 36288362​​, and a+b+c=3+62+8=73a+b+c=3+62+8=73​.
Practice
Write 21404021​​ as abccab​​ with bb squarefree, the fraction in lowest terms, and cc positive, where aa may be 11. Enter b+cb+c, b plus c, as a single number.
Show the solution
2140=2140=21210=21⋅102⋅10=210204021​​=40​21​​=210​21​​=2⋅1021​⋅10​​=20210​​, so b+c=210+20=230b+c=210+20=230​. Simplifying 4040​ first kept every number small.
Practice
Write 2587575258​​ as abccab​​ with bb squarefree, the fraction in lowest terms, and cc positive, where aa may be 11. Reduce the fraction under the radical first. Enter b+cb+c, b plus c, as a single number.
Show the solution
25875=862575258​=2586​, so 25875=8625=86575258​​=25​86​​=586​​ and b+c=86+5=91b+c=86+5=91​. Reducing first left a perfect square downstairs, so there was nothing to rationalize.
Practice
Evaluate 284639639284​​ exactly, reducing the fraction under the radical first. Enter your answer as a fraction in lowest terms.
Show the solution
284=4⋅71284=4⋅71 and 639=9⋅71639=9⋅71, so 284639=49639284​=94​ and 49=49=2394​​=9​4​​=32​​. No radical remains, since both parts of the reduced fraction are perfect squares.
Practice
Rationalize the cube-root denominator in 110933109​1​. The result has the form n31091093n​​. Enter nn.
Show the solution
11093⋅1092310923=1092310933=1188131093109​1​⋅31092​31092​​=31093​31092​​=109311881​​, so n=11881n=11881​. Multiplying by just one more copy would leave 1092331092​ downstairs, still irrational.
Practice
22201=149222201=1492, so 222013322201​ already holds two copies of 149149. To rationalize 1222013322201​1​, multiply by n3n33n​3n​​ with nn as small as possible. Enter nn.
Show the solution
14923⋅1493=14933=14931492​⋅3149​=31493​=149, so n=149n=149​ and the fraction becomes 14931491493149​​. Multiplying by 222012322201233222012​3222012​​ also works but brings in far bigger numbers for the same answer.
Practice
Compute 3978+78278​39​+278​​. Once the first term is in standard form, the sum collapses to a single radical nn​. Enter nn.
Show the solution
3978=397878=78278​39​=783978​​=278​​, so the sum is 782+782=2782=78278​​+278​​=2278​​=78​ and n=78n=78​. The two terms were equal all along, and standard form is what made that visible.
Practice
Write 4794+94494​47​+494​​ as one fraction abccab​​ with bb squarefree, the fraction in lowest terms, and cc positive. Enter a+b+ca+b+c, a plus b plus c, as a single number.
Show the solution
4794=479494=942=294494​47​=944794​​=294​​=4294​​, so the sum is 2944+944=39444294​​+494​​=4394​​ and a+b+c=3+94+4=101a+b+c=3+94+4=101​. Neither term could combine with the other until the radical left the denominator.
Practice
Write 201134−134134​201​−134​ as one fraction abccab​​ with bb squarefree, the fraction in lowest terms, and cc positive, where aa may be 11. Enter b+cb+c, b plus c, as a single number.
Show the solution
201134=201134134=31342134​201​=134201134​​=23134​​, and 134=21342134​=22134​​, so the difference is 31342−21342=134223134​​−22134​​=2134​​ and b+c=134+2=136b+c=134+2=136​. The whole coefficient collapses to 11, which is why the ask allows a=1a=1.
